llm_response.reason: The website displays a vast range of randomly assorted products at unusually low prices and claims universal free shipping. The listed company name is generic and not clearly associated with any real business, for which search results reveal ongoing impersonation and police reports of fake sites using similar names. Critical business and privacy info are vague or missing. These factors fit the scam patterns: (1) unusually low prices/free claims, (4) faked company info, (5) handling of disparate product types, (7) ambiguous privacy info, and (16) spoofed legitimate company branding.
